review_mode: read_only_source; only this JSON written inside repo

nodes.label: AppTheme
nodes.rationale: Keep semantic colors dynamic; changing persistent keys alone must also invalidate visible views.

nodes.label: AppIcon glass book and purple ribbon

findings.evidence: 跟随系统 appears as both status Text and Button in the same brightness HStack. ThemeMode itself contains only one .system case.
findings.recommendation: In system mode display a single selected system action; in manual mode show percentage plus restore-system action. Do not change global theme mode to solve this.
findings.ios16_risk: Existing Slider/Button and conditional Text are iOS 16 compatible.

findings.evidence: Settings already limits visible diagnostics to 12 events and copies all, but expands every event detail directly in the main settings list.
findings.recommendation: Replace main list dump with a compact NavigationLink row; dedicated diagnostics list/detail offers copy event, copy all, text selection and clear/export as deliberate actions. Keep counts/caps explicit.
findings.ios16_risk: NavigationStack, NavigationLink, UIPasteboard and .textSelection work on iOS 16; avoid iOS 17-only ContentUnavailableView.

findings.evidence: App-wide purple accent and UIColor are static let constants, plus softBlue; no custom accent keys or observable theme palette. App entry observes only themeMode.
findings.recommendation: Add persisted primary/secondary RGB colors with validation/reset; derive both Color and UIColor from one palette. Ensure App-level observed change invalidates SwiftUI and representable updates; use UIKit dynamic colors for dark/light contrast. Include AppState backup/reset key lists.
findings.ios16_risk: ColorPicker is compatible. Do not recreate RootTabView with .id on palette changes, which would discard navigation/reader state. iOS 17 onChange(initial:) or symbolEffect unavailable.

findings.evidence: Only active root exists; selected change uses opacity transition and a selected background created/destroyed per button; outer easeOut 0.16 and explicit spring coexist.
findings.recommendation: Use one matchedGeometryEffect selection capsule in stable tab row with one animation policy; keep active-root optimization (do not restore three live complex navigation trees). Support Reduce Motion with near-instant or gentle fade.
findings.ios16_risk: matchedGeometryEffect and accessibilityReduceMotion work on iOS 16; avoid symbolEffect, phaseAnimator, keyframeAnimator, sensoryFeedback.

findings.evidence: Settings hero is a large bespoke secondary-card inside a Section with metrics; aesthetics are subjective, not a functional defect.
findings.recommendation: Simplify to compact icon + display name + version, move stats to discrete rows or source area; retain readable typography and Dynamic Type without nested borders.
findings.ios16_risk: Use system List and text styles. Do not add iOS 26 glass APIs or fixed-height header clipping.

findings.evidence: Extract action loads a brand-new hidden WKWebView from initial loadedURL, not current displayed DOM; redirects/SPA clicks or logged-in current article can be lost. Visible SmartWebView has no navigation coordinator/current URL binding.
findings.recommendation: Expose controlled browser model holding current webview; extract document.documentElement.outerHTML from that exact view after user action. Track navigated URL. Add loading/failure/provisional-failure and cancellation cleanup with no delegate retain cycle. Reuse for login web browser.
findings.ios16_risk: WKWebView evaluateJavaScript is iOS 16-compatible; callbacks should return UI state on MainActor, avoid stale callback updates after dismissal.

findings.evidence: Login web surface uses shared cookie store and supports gestures; no extraction action or current web-view handle. Reloading loginURL elsewhere would not necessarily retain current article path.
findings.recommendation: Add visible-web snapshot extraction button only for web mode; keep login/finish behavior untouched and show native reader projection in a separate sheet/route. Do not copy credentials or cookie values into diagnostics/artifact.
findings.ios16_risk: Use sheet with NavigationStack on iOS 16. No URLSession fallback for authenticated current DOM.

findings.evidence: Visible and hidden WKWebViews use default configuration and no WKContentRuleList; boilerplate stripping happens after network load, so it does not block ads.
findings.reuse_entry: Shared WKWebView configuration factory for ordinary reading pages
findings.recommendation: Add conservative compile-once WKContentRuleList for known third-party ad resources plus popup navigation policy and site allow/disable switch. Distinguish network blocking from native extraction cleanup. Do not apply blanket script/iframe block to login/CAPTCHA. Do not promise all ads blocked.
findings.ios16_risk: WKContentRuleListStore is available on iOS 16; compile/cache async and avoid loading until rule installation resolved. Ensure policy does not break auth windows.

findings.evidence: Candidate union ends in body and takes candidates.first (not best text density); structured extraction ignores br-only novel blocks. Global Set deduplication removes repeated legitimate paragraphs/dialogue anywhere in the article.
findings.recommendation: Score article/main/content candidates rather than first traversal result; preserve br/newline paragraphs and single-character meaningful content; only remove structural boilerplate and adjacent exact duplicate chrome, not arbitrary repeated dialogue. Add fixtures with small teaser before body, br-only novel, repeated dialogue, ad iframe, empty auth page.
findings.ios16_risk: SwiftSoup and Foundation compatible; process large DOM away from MainActor where data isolation allows.

findings.evidence: Presets are not auto-installed on first launch. Existing optional noise rule 『.*?』## deletes legitimate quoted/emphasized novel text. Broad .*下载.*app.* may delete narrative discussion, and defaults must not silently corrupt existing books.
findings.reuse_entry: PurifyRuleStore.importPatterns + PurifyRulePreset + PurifyRulesView preview and enable controls
findings.recommendation: Ship versioned conservative standalone line-anchored ad/footer rules; separate safe recommended defaults and aggressive opt-in examples. Remove blanket quote deletion from recommended set; idempotent seed migration must respect explicit user opt-out/deletion. Keep JS/regex import, preview, per-rule toggles and original content recoverability.
findings.ios16_risk: Foundation regex works on iOS 16; avoid pathological regex and repeated recompilation in tight reader loop; test source text conservation when no pattern matches.

findings.evidence: LAN web UI is embedded literal in SourceWritingView.swift getWebPageHtml, not separate HTML resource; fixed dark slate palette, emoji toolbar, 480px editor, no theme-responsive media query in style block.
findings.reuse_entry: getWebPageHtml; existing IDs, JS handlers, /api routes
findings.recommendation: Restyle embedded UI without breaking IDs/routes: grouped light neutral surfaces, restrained accent, system fonts, compact sidebar/tab workspace, responsive actions, dark-mode and prefers-reduced-motion support. Extract HTML into maintainable factory/resource only if Xcode target includes it. Validate import/export/debug/source list APIs, keyboard focus and mobile widths.
findings.ios16_risk: Safari iOS 16 supports CSS grid/flex/dark-mode/reduced-motion. Avoid unguarded view-transitions or newer CSS-only requirements; no external CDN/font dependency on LAN.

findings.evidence: Current bundled icon visually shows pearlescent glass open book floating over a purple folded ribbon on white rounded tile; actual CFBundleDisplayName is 纸间, not SourceReadSwift or IPA filename.
findings.recommendation: Subjective: 纸间 is concise and literary; keep. Icon palette matches brand and conveys reading, but glass edges lack small-size contrast and ribbon/detail feels more decorative than memorable. Keep current icon for stability; if revised, simplify silhouette and compare 60px/40px previews, dark wallpaper, grayscale. No new icon generated in this review.
findings.ios16_risk: Asset catalog universal iOS icon; no platform-specific redesign API needed.

limitations: No native iOS build or device UI executed by this reviewer.
Aesthetic appraisal is subjective, not a defect diagnosis.
Runtime layout/performance claims remain unverified until targeted regression and device checks.
